content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.

Erecting wind turbines requires massive crawler cranes operating on perfectly stable pads. We provide engineered designs to create high-bearing-capacity crane pads. Safety is key with a crane pad, so ensure you have the best foundation platform in the business.

Baselok engineered solutions eliminate the risk of crane settlement or tipping during critical lifting operations.

Large-scale solar farms often span variable soil and site conditions. Baselok products are the go-to for many contractors and developers to reinforce subgrades for solar farm perimeter, maintenance, and emergency access roads.  Our products are also utilized for the construction of large laydown yards and equipment yards, which are critical on every project.

Millions of sq yards of Baselok geogrids and FabGrid have been utilized on Solar Farm projects all over North America.  Let our Engineering Team show you the benefits of reducing aggregate, eliminating chemical stabilization, overcoming saturated sub-grades, and constructing more expediently.
